examples.title: Create a GeoNormals node
examples.code:
# Create the node and keep a reference to it.
geoNormals = nuke.createNode("GeoNormals")

provenance.editorial_note: Node class is present in the locked scanner dataset; Foundry toolbar source is used where the class is exposed in the standard toolbar.

examples.title: Insert the node into an existing pipe
examples.code:
# Connect an existing source to input 0.
geoNormals = nuke.createNode("GeoNormals")
geoNormals.setInput(0, source)

# Configure the "action" control.
geoNormals = nuke.createNode("GeoNormals")
geoNormals["action"].setValue("set")
